name: Chloe Rouen
source:
"Eek!? D-Do you need something from me......?"

Chloe's the youngest student in the magic academy's history, and she's got a full plate. She's not just hitting the books - she's also [url=/c135126]Princess Fine[/url]'s shadow, playing the role of a loyal attendant. When it comes to people, Chloe's as shy as they come, with a timid streak a mile wide. Looks like she drew the short straw in the health department too, often seeming under the weather.

But don't let that fool you - this girl's got her nose in the books more than most. She's a walking encyclopedia on magic and old legends. In class, she flies under the radar, but word on the street is she might be keeping her true skills under wraps.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/character_chloe.html]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Her true name is Croche.[/spoiler]
